reviews.text:
Frustratingly Still the Worst Streaming App

I’ve used Hayu many times over the years, and honestly, it’s still one of the worst streaming apps I’ve ever used. I took a break from it and came back thinking that with all the improvements in technology, surely the app would have improved too — but unfortunately, it hasn’t.

That being said, the price is still very competitive… and because of that I will continue to pay for my membership since I enjoy the content.

reviews.title: Cancelled due to lack of care and support
reviews.text:
I have had a HAYU account for years and years, came to renew this time, re subscribed, and then had problem after problem. It kept saying ‘renew’ - support and customer services SHOCKING!! 
No help at all. Asked me to reinstall, sign in and out, clear cache, all done and still the same. In the end I got that frustrated I’ve deleted the subscription and asked for a refund. Absolute BS that they couldn’t help, terrible service!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Infuriating App
reviews.text: Love the shows, the housewives franchise is my comfort watch but omg I can’t get passed how bad the app is. I watch the shows mainly on my ipad and more often than not I get some kind of error pop up and can’t watch the shows I want. Deleting the app and redownloading is what they recommend which does nothing. The app on a smart tv is somehow even worse. It freezes as soon as I click on anything and I have to turn off my TV. Cancelling my subscription because of these issues.

reviews.title: Awful

reviews.title: Worst paid app ever made
reviews.text: I always wonder whether the people who work at Hayu ever actually use their own app. I think they don’t. Otherwise they would notice that shows are not sorted correctly. I.E. why do I have to scroll all the way down to the latest season then scroll all the way down to the latest episode? It takes forever just to find the correct episode. Also we use a 65 inch Samsung tv. I can’t read the name of each show I.E. Real housewives. They use the smallest font possible. Oh don’t get me started about “continue watching” that’s just potluck. App also constantly crashes. This is why I ask, do the people who work at Hayu actually use the app? I bet they don’t, because the user interface requires a big overhaul. Seems like they got their website/app made by a freelancer for minimum bid.

reviews.title: One star. Constantly broken. Waste of money.
reviews.text:
Every single time I try to use this app, I get the same error message saying something “went wrong” and to try again later. Later never comes. It doesn’t matter what I try to watch, what day it is, or how many times I reopen the app. It just doesn’t work.

This isn’t a rare glitch. This is the default experience.

I have no issues with other streaming apps on the same device or Wi-Fi, so this is clearly a Hayu problem. I genuinely don’t understand why I’m paying a subscription fee for a service that is consistently unusable.

If you’re thinking of subscribing, don’t. If you already are, good luck actually watching anything.

reviews.title: Unreliable and frustrating
reviews.text:
Considering this is a paid app, my expectation is that users would could use this app 85% of the time without issue, however it is the opposite.
I continue to pay for this app for the content as I am not able to view these shows elsewhere / in one place.
This is be far the worst streaming app, and probably the worst app I’ve used for reliability. I have regularly been caught out travelling when I download a show and then go to watch it on airplane mode and it crashes. Even trying to watch in ideal situations- 5G/wifi the app constantly crashes.
This needs a complete overhaul, and it is disappointing and beyond frustrating that with all the feedback of the same issues, and these same issues ongoing for years, there have been no improvements. Users have to deal with the poor experience, because there are no alternatives.

reviews.title: Love the content but it JUST. WONT. LOAD. Again.
reviews.text:
Dec 2025 review: Yes I am still watching… for now. Or trying to. 
Hayu! What are you doing? You got better for a while there, and now you’re back to “JWT token expired” and just black screens of nothingness. Every time I go to watch. Multiple times. 
This is getting tired. 
I think your time is also expired with me and I will find the content with one of your competitors unless a change is made soon. Can you please investigate these issues! I have waited a couple of app updates hoping you’d find and run the script to fix these issues, but nope. Like I said, you got better but now are back to your old ways…


2021 review: This app has been great. I have been using it on my Apple TV for over a year, no problems. Loving the content. Don’t mind the difficulty finding things (I can just search for it if it’s not forthcoming), BUT... 
Lately every time I go to watch something, it just sits there with the black loading “hayu. Loading.... hayu content is not suitable for children - please see content ratings” page and the spinning wheel. Indefinitely. The only way to get around it is to delete the app on the Apple TV, and re-download, then re-pair it to my account again. If this could be fixed, I will be one happy camper again!!
